caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate glass vase with a diamond-patterned texture covering its body. The vase has a flared, ruffled rim at the top, and a rounded, faceted stem that widens into a circular, patterned base. The glass is rendered in shades of clear blue, white, and gray, giving it the appearance of transparency and reflection. Behind the vase is a solid black rectangular strip that stretches horizontally across the composition, intersecting the central part of the vase's body and providing contrast to the glass. The background surrounding the vase and black strip is a plain, off-white or light beige color.
title: Celery Holder
